## Recreational Fishery

```{r cars}
catch <- ReadCatch(
  file.path(
    "https://apps-st.fisheries.noaa.gov/st1/recreational/MRIP_Estimate_Data/CSV/Wave%20Level%20Estimate%20Downloads",
    "mrip_catch_bywave_2025.csv"), 34, 1:6)

catch <- catch[catch$COMMON=="WEAKFISH",]
```

* New Jersey landed `r sum(catch$LBS_AB1)` pounds of weakfish in their recreational fishery in 2024. 
* New Jersey landed `r sum(catch$LANDING)` weakfish in their recreational fishery in 2024. 
* New Jersey released `r sum(catch$ESTREL)` weakfish in their recreational fishery in 2024.
